config_note: Canonical Full50 extension; physiology, fixed motor13 Riemann, frozen S-JEPA, and all-cohort transductive neutral-state microstates.
preprocessing_order: independent full 8-s trial filter, then marker-relative 0-4 s crop
topomap_interpretation: MI-window log bandpower right-hand minus left-hand; positive values are higher for right-hand trials and are not baseline-normalized ERD

model.riemann: fixed motor13 OAS 8-30 Hz 4s+2s+1s fold-local tangent/scaler/shrinkage-LDA
model.microstate: four-state all-configured-cohort transductive group maps; neutral states make no canonical claim

global_metrics.primary_estimand: within-subject left-vs-right separation and same-dataset association with decoding

physiology_cohort_effects.correction: BH across all channel x band and prespecified homologous/asymmetry cohort tests

multiplicity.physiology_local: BH within subject x band x declared family
multiplicity.physiology_cohort: BH across all channel x band and prespecified homologous/asymmetry cohort tests
